privacyIntroductionContent: KSA Cosmetics is committed to protecting user privacy in accordance with applicable Syrian laws, including the Electronic Personal Data Protection Law No. 12 of 2024.
privacyDataCollectContent:
• Basic personal data (name, phone, email).
• Address, shipping, and geolocation data.
• Account data and product preferences.
• Health data (prescriptions) protected with absolute confidentiality.
privacyLegalBasisContent: We process your data based on your explicit consent, performance of the sales contract, compliance with legal obligations (health and tax), or legitimate interest in improving our services.
privacyPurposesContent: Data is used to manage your account, execute orders, process payments, communicate with you, provide technical support, and comply with Syrian health and customs regulations.
privacySharingContent: We never sell your data. We only share necessary information with authorized shipping companies and licensed payment gateways within Syria, or judicial authorities upon official legal request.
privacySecurityContent: We use SSL/TLS protocols for data encryption, password encryption via bcrypt algorithms, and a strict access control system with advanced firewalls.
privacyRightsContent: According to Law No. 12 of 2024, you have the right to access, correct, delete, object to processing, or withdraw your consent at any time.
privacyChildrenContent: Our services are directed to adults aged 18 and over. We do not intentionally collect data from children; any such data is deleted immediately.
privacyLinksContent: Our app may contain links to external sites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices and recommend you review their policies.
privacyLawContent: This policy is subject to applicable Syrian laws, and Syrian courts in Damascus have exclusive jurisdiction over any disputes.
aboutUsIntroContent: KSA Cosmetics is a leading Syrian project and an integrated electronic platform that brings together the worlds of Pharmacy and Cosmetics under one roof.
aboutUsMissionContent: To be the first and most trusted destination for the Syrian family in everything related to health and beauty.
aboutUsVisionContent: To make a qualitative leap in the sector of pharmacy and electronic cosmetics in Syria, by merging modern technology with ancient pharmaceutical expertise.
termsIntroContent: Welcome to KSA Cosmetics. By using this app, you agree to comply with the following terms and conditions in accordance with applicable laws.
termsUsageContent: The app must be used for its intended purposes only. Any unauthorized use is strictly prohibited.
termsPrivacyContent: Your privacy is important to us. Please review our Privacy Policy to understand how your data is processed.

syria_faq_sec1_content: KSA Cosmetics is a comprehensive Syrian e-commerce platform that brings pharmaceutical products and cosmetics together under one roof, offering you a safe and trusted shopping experience with delivery to all Syrian governorates.
syria_faq_sec2_content: Registration on the platform is completely free. You can create an account by clicking 'Create Account' and entering your details (name, email, phone number). You can also shop as a guest, but creating an account grants you additional benefits such as order tracking and a loyalty program.
syria_faq_sec3_content: You can search for products via the search bar or browse categories. After selecting a product, add it to your cart and click 'Checkout'. You can modify or cancel your order before the shipping stage.
syria_faq_sec4_content: We offer multiple payment methods including cash on delivery, bank transfer, and electronic payment gateways approved by the Central Bank of Syria. All your financial transactions are fully encrypted and secure.
syria_faq_sec5_content: We cover all Syrian governorates. Delivery within Damascus takes 24-48 hours, and to other governorates 2-7 business days. Shipping fees depend on the destination and order weight and are clearly shown at checkout.
syria_faq_sec6_content: You have the right to request a return within 14 days of receipt for unused products in their original condition. Medications and some personal care products are non-returnable for health reasons.
syria_faq_sec7_content: All our medications are original and registered with the Syrian Ministry of Health. We retain medical prescriptions for medications that require them, and we comply with the highest storage and refrigeration standards to ensure efficacy.
syria_faq_sec8_content: Our team is available 24/7 via live chat in the app or via WhatsApp at +963-967822996. We are committed to responding to all inquiries and complaints within less than 24 hours.
syria_licenses_intro_content: At KSA Cosmetics, we believe that trust is built on transparency and credibility. Therefore, on this page we present all official licenses and accreditations that authorize us to operate in the Syrian Arab Republic. We are a fully licensed platform operating in accordance with Syrian laws and regulations, subject to continuous oversight by the relevant regulatory authorities, ensuring the safety of our customers and the quality of our products.

syria_policy_intro:
At KSA Cosmetics, we strive to deliver your order as quickly as possible with the highest levels of safety and quality. This policy clarifies all details related to shipping and delivery, from coverage areas to fees, timeframes, and your rights as a customer.

This policy is subject to the provisions of:
- Syrian Commercial Law No. (33) of 2007.
- Syrian Consumer Protection Law No. (8) of 2008.
- Syrian Land Transport Law and related regulations.
syria_policy_shipping_sec1_sub2_item1: Some remote areas may be subject to longer delivery times, additional shipping fees, and conditional availability depending on road conditions and security situation. You will be notified in advance before order confirmation.
syria_policy_shipping_sec1_sub3_item1: Our services are currently limited to within Syrian territory only.
syria_policy_shipping_sec1_sub3_item2: We are studying the possibility of expanding to neighboring countries in the future.
syria_policy_shipping_sec2_sub2_item1: Timeframes are calculated from the order confirmation date (not submission date).
syria_policy_shipping_sec2_sub2_item2: Orders placed after 4:00 PM are counted from the next day.
syria_policy_shipping_sec2_sub2_item3: Official holidays are not counted within the timeframe.
syria_policy_shipping_sec2_sub2_item4: Timeframes are estimates and may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
syria_policy_shipping_sec2_sub3_item1: Standard Delivery: As per the table.
syria_policy_shipping_sec2_sub3_item2: Express Delivery: In Damascus and its countryside (3-6 hours).
syria_policy_shipping_sec2_sub3_item3: Same-Day Delivery: For orders placed before 11:00 AM in Damascus.
syria_policy_shipping_sec3_sub1_content: Fees are calculated based on the destination, weight, speed, and product type (standard/refrigerated/fragile).
syria_policy_shipping_sec3_sub2_content: Final fees are clearly displayed upon order completion before payment.
syria_policy_shipping_sec3_sub4_item1: Re-delivery after a failed first attempt.
syria_policy_shipping_sec4_item1: You will receive a special tracking number via email, SMS, and app notification.
syria_policy_shipping_sec4_row4_value: Order is on its way to you
syria_policy_shipping_sec6_item1: The customer or their authorized representative must be present with valid ID.
syria_policy_shipping_sec6_item2: Prescription medications are only delivered to the designated person or an authorized representative with written authorization.
syria_policy_shipping_sec6_item3: We advise checking packaging integrity, the invoice, and expiry dates upon receipt.
syria_policy_shipping_sec6_item4: We make 3 delivery attempts within 48 hours before returning the order to the warehouse.
syria_policy_shipping_sec7_content: Delays may occur due to weather conditions, security situations, traffic, or force majeure. We commit to notifying you immediately and giving you the option to cancel if the delay exceeds 7 days.
syria_policy_shipping_sec7_item1: Compensation: We may offer discounts or loyalty points in case of unjustified delay.
syria_policy_shipping_sec8_item1: Modifications can be made before shipping via the app or customer service.
syria_policy_shipping_sec8_item2: After shipping, modifications are only possible in exceptional cases with additional fees.
syria_policy_shipping_sec9_item1: Heat-sensitive products: insulated packaging and cooling elements.
syria_policy_shipping_sec9_item2: Fragile products: special glass and ampoule packaging.
syria_policy_shipping_sec9_item3: Restricted products: require a prescription or proof documents.
syria_policy_shipping_sec10_item1: Clear information about fees and delivery time.
syria_policy_shipping_sec10_item2: Tracking order status and refusing damaged deliveries.
syria_policy_shipping_sec10_item3: Contacting customer service and filing complaints.
syria_policy_shipping_sec11_item1: Response within 24 hours for urgent complaints.
syria_policy_shipping_sec11_item2: Required information: order number, problem description, and illustrative photos.
syria_policy_returns_intro: At KSA Cosmetics, your complete satisfaction is our primary goal. This policy explains in detail your rights and obligations regarding product returns or exchanges, in accordance with Syrian Consumer Protection Law No. (8) of 2008 and related laws.
syria_policy_returns_sec1_sub1_item1: 14 days is the basic deadline for requesting a return in accordance with Syrian Consumer Protection Law.
syria_policy_returns_sec1_sub1_item2: The deadline is calculated from the date you received your order.
syria_policy_returns_sec1_sub2_item1: Must be in its original condition and unused.
syria_policy_returns_sec1_sub2_item2: Must be in its original sealed packaging.
syria_policy_returns_sec1_sub2_item3: All labels and seals must be intact.
syria_policy_returns_sec1_sub2_item4: Purchase invoice or order number must be available.
syria_policy_returns_sec1_sub3_item1: The original customer who made the purchase.
syria_policy_returns_sec1_sub3_item2: A person with written authorization from the original customer.
syria_policy_returns_sec2_sub1_title: 2.1 Case One: Return Without a Specific Reason
syria_policy_returns_sec2_sub1_content: You have the right to return the product within 14 days of receipt, even without a specific reason. In this case, the customer bears the reverse shipping costs.
syria_policy_returns_sec2_sub2_title: 2.2 Case Two: Defective or Damaged Product
syria_policy_returns_sec2_sub2_content: If you receive a defective, damaged, or malfunctioning product, you have the right to a full return or immediate exchange with a full refund including shipping fees. Deadline: 48 hours from receipt to report.
syria_policy_returns_sec2_sub3_title: 2.3 Case Three: Product Different from Ordered
syria_policy_returns_sec2_sub3_content: If you receive a product different from what was ordered, you have the right to return or exchange for the correct product. Deadline: 7 days from receipt to report.
syria_policy_returns_sec2_sub4_content: You have the right to immediate return and a full refund + shipping fees.
syria_policy_returns_sec2_sub5_title: 2.5 Case Five: Counterfeit or Non-Original Product
syria_policy_returns_sec2_sub5_content: If a product is proven to be counterfeit (which is unlikely with us), a full refund plus additional compensation will be provided.
syria_policy_returns_sec2_sub6_content: According to Syrian Civil Law, if you discover a hidden defect, you have the right to return within a reasonable period from the discovery of the defect (maximum one month from discovery and 6 months from receipt).
syria_policy_returns_sec3_sub1_item1: Medications of all types (prescription and non-prescription).
syria_policy_returns_sec3_sub2_item1: Cosmetics that have been opened or used.
syria_policy_returns_sec3_sub2_item2: Skincare products after breaking the seal.
syria_policy_returns_sec3_sub3_item2: Opened toothbrushes and oral care products.
syria_policy_returns_sec3_sub4_item1: Products sold in final special offers.
syria_policy_returns_sec4_item1: Step 1: Submit a return request via phone +963-967822996 or email, mentioning the order number and reason.
syria_policy_returns_sec4_item2: Step 2: Request reviewed within 24 - 48 hours and a Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) number issued.
syria_policy_returns_sec4_item3: Step 3: Prepare the package in its original packaging with the authorization number.
syria_policy_returns_sec4_item4: Step 4: Ship the product via a shipping company we select for you.
syria_policy_returns_sec4_item5: Step 5: Inspection and evaluation within 3 - 5 business days.
syria_policy_returns_sec4_item6: Step 6: Refund within 7 - 14 business days or exchange.
syria_policy_returns_sec5_sub1_content: The amount is refunded via the same original payment method, except in exceptional cases agreed upon with the customer.
syria_policy_returns_sec5_sub3_item1: Full product value in case of defect or company error.
syria_policy_returns_sec5_sub3_item2: Original shipping fees in case of defect or company error.
syria_policy_returns_sec5_sub3_item3: Reverse shipping fees are borne by the customer in case of return without reason.
syria_policy_returns_sec5_sub4_content: You can choose to receive the refund as a balance in your e-wallet on the platform, in which case the refund is immediate, and we may offer an additional bonus of 5 - 10% of the refunded amount as an incentive.
syria_policy_returns_sec6_sub1_item1: In case of defect or damage, it is replaced with the same product immediately at no extra charge.
syria_policy_returns_sec6_sub2_item1: Same value: Exchange is made directly.
syria_policy_returns_sec6_sub2_item2: Higher value: Customer pays the difference.
syria_policy_returns_sec6_sub2_item3: Lower value: The difference is returned to the wallet balance or payment method.
syria_policy_returns_sec6_sub3_item1: Due to defect or our error: We cover all shipping fees.
syria_policy_returns_sec6_sub3_item2: At customer's request: Customer bears shipping fees in both directions.
syria_policy_returns_sec7_sub1_content: You have the right to refuse to receive the order upon arrival if the packaging appears damaged or you notice a broken security seal. In this case, no fees are charged and the full amount is refunded.
syria_policy_returns_sec7_sub2_content: You can return some products from the order and not all of them. The refunded amount is calculated for the returned products only.
syria_policy_returns_sec7_sub3_content: Products purchased at discounts are subject to the same return policy. The actually paid amount is refunded. Some products in final clearance sales are non-returnable.
syria_policy_returns_sec7_sub4_content: When returning a product associated with a free gift, the gift must also be returned. If the gift is not returned, its value will be deducted from the refunded amount.
syria_policy_returns_sec7_sub5_title: 7.5 Orders Paid with Cashback or Loyalty Points
syria_policy_returns_sec7_sub5_content: Points or cashback are returned to your balance and are not directly converted to cash.
syria_policy_returns_sec8_content: We reserve the right to refuse requests in cases of excessive repeated returns, returning used products, product tampering, or providing false information.
syria_policy_returns_sec9_item1: Right to information, choice, safety, fair compensation, and the right to appeal.
syria_policy_returns_sec9_content: Reference authorities: Consumer Protection Directorate, Syrian Consumer Protection Association, and competent Syrian courts.
syria_policy_returns_sec10_item2: Validity guarantee (6 months for medications and 9 months for cosmetics).
syria_policy_returns_sec10_item3: Cold chain and storage quality guarantee.
syria_policy_returns_sec11_item1: Delivery delay: Discount on the next order.
syria_policy_returns_sec11_item2: Defective/wrong product: Replacement + voucher or free shipping.
syria_policy_returns_sec12_content: Written objection within 15 days of rejection. Response within 3 business days and final decision within 7 days.
syria_policy_returns_sec14_item1: This policy is considered an integral part of the General Terms and Conditions.
syria_policy_returns_sec14_item2: The provisions most beneficial to the customer apply in case of conflict.
syria_policy_returns_sec14_item3: The Arabic version is the officially adopted version.
